step: Validate vocabulary source registry and gate
command:
python tools/vocabulary/gate_sources.py --snapshot docs/data/snapshot.json --json
python -m unittest discover -s tools/vocabulary -p 'test_*.py' -v

step: Test catalog builder and credit consistency validator
Validate vocabulary contract and canonical catalog
Verify ingestion reproducibility and fixture release rejection
command:
python tools/vocabulary/verify_ingestion.py --fixture --config tools/vocabulary/fixtures/ingestion/verified/config.json --output build/vocabulary-ingestion/data06-ci-proof
python docs/data/vocabulary-contract-v1/validate_contract.py build/vocabulary-ingestion/data06-ci-proof/a/canonical-catalog.json
set +e
python docs/data/vocabulary-contract-v1/validate_contract.py build/vocabulary-ingestion/data06-ci-proof/a/canonical-catalog.json --release
release_status=$?
set -e
test "$release_status" -eq 1

step: Verify vocabulary QC and refusal to publish unreviewed content
command:
python tools/vocabulary/quality.py --fixture --input build/vocabulary-ingestion/data06-ci-proof/a --config tools/vocabulary/fixtures/ingestion/verified/config.json --reviews tools/vocabulary/fixtures/quality/reviews.json --output build/vocabulary-quality/data06-ci-a
python tools/vocabulary/quality.py --fixture --input build/vocabulary-ingestion/data06-ci-proof/a --config tools/vocabulary/fixtures/ingestion/verified/config.json --reviews tools/vocabulary/fixtures/quality/reviews.json --output build/vocabulary-quality/data06-ci-b
diff -r build/vocabulary-quality/data06-ci-a build/vocabulary-quality/data06-ci-b
python docs/data/vocabulary-contract-v1/validate_contract.py build/vocabulary-quality/data06-ci-a/canonical-catalog.json
set +e
python tools/vocabulary/quality.py --fixture --input build/vocabulary-ingestion/data06-ci-proof/a --config tools/vocabulary/fixtures/ingestion/verified/config.json --reviews tools/vocabulary/fixtures/quality/pending-reviews.json --output build/vocabulary-quality/data06-ci-rejected
qc_status=$?
set -e
test "$qc_status" -eq 1
test ! -e build/vocabulary-quality/data06-ci-rejected/manifest.json
test ! -e build/vocabulary-quality/data06-ci-rejected/canonical-catalog.json
test ! -e build/vocabulary-quality/data06-ci-rejected/validated_vocab.jsonl

step: Verify editorial corpus reproducibility and approval blockers
command:
set +e
python tools/vocabulary/prepare_corpus.py --require-approved --output build/vocabulary-corpus/data06-ci-a
corpus_a_status=$?
python tools/vocabulary/prepare_corpus.py --require-approved --output build/vocabulary-corpus/data06-ci-b
corpus_b_status=$?
set -e
test "$corpus_a_status" -eq 1
test "$corpus_b_status" -eq 1
diff -r build/vocabulary-corpus/data06-ci-a build/vocabulary-corpus/data06-ci-b
diff -r docs/data/voc-data-04/corpus-v1 build/vocabulary-corpus/data06-ci-a
test ! -e build/vocabulary-corpus/data06-ci-a/manifest.json
test ! -e build/vocabulary-corpus/data06-ci-a/validated_vocab.jsonl
set +e
python tools/vocabulary/ingest.py --config docs/data/voc-data-04/corpus-v1/ingestion-proposal.json --output build/vocabulary-ingestion/data06-editorial-approval-check
editorial_status=$?
set -e
test "$editorial_status" -eq 1
test ! -e build/vocabulary-ingestion/data06-editorial-approval-check/manifest.json

python tools/vocabulary/accept_editorial.py --output build/vocabulary-corpus/data06-accepted-ci
diff -r docs/data/voc-data-04/accepted-v1 build/vocabulary-corpus/data06-accepted-ci
python tools/vocabulary/ingest.py --config docs/data/voc-data-04/accepted-v1/ingestion-config.json --output build/vocabulary-ingestion/data06-accepted-ci
python tools/vocabulary/quality.py --input build/vocabulary-ingestion/data06-accepted-ci --config docs/data/voc-data-04/accepted-v1/ingestion-config.json --reviews docs/data/voc-data-04/accepted-v1/reviews.json --output build/vocabulary-quality/data06-ci-accepted
python docs/data/vocabulary-contract-v1/validate_contract.py build/vocabulary-quality/data06-ci-accepted/canonical-catalog.json --release
python tools/vocabulary/accept_editorial.py --verify build/vocabulary-quality/data06-ci-accepted
